meta.rationale: A heads-up display: a turning targeting reticle in the middle of the screen, your apps locked onto as targets around it.
meta.theme-about: sci-fi heads-up display: a full-screen canvas with a large animated targeting reticle at the centre (rotating dashed rings, tick marks, a sweeping arc, a pulsing core), the apps as bracketed targets placed around it at fixed angles with thin leader lines and coordinate readouts, the one under the pointer locks on in amber; corner brackets, telemetry text and the time in the corners; cyan line art on black, angular windows with cut corners. Iron Man, cockpit, precise. (#hud, #tele)

desktop.canvas: local targets, hot = {}, nil local C, A = "rgba(38,224,255,", "rgba(255,176,32," function draw(w, h, t) local cx, cy = w / 2, h / 2 for k = 0, 3 do local r = 90 + k * 46 local n = 24 + k * 12 local sp = (k % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * (0.15 + k * 0.05) for i = 0, n - 1 do if (i % 3) ~= 0 then local a0 = i / n * 6.283 + t * sp g.arc(cx, cy, r, a0, a0 + 6.283 / n * 0.6, C .. (0.25 + 0.12 * (3 - k)) .. ")", k == 0 and 3 or 1.5) end end end for i = 0, 71 do local a = i / 72 * 6.283 local r1, r2 = 270, i % 6 == 0 and 290 or 280 g.line(cx + math.cos(a) * r1, cy + math.sin(a) * r1, cx + math.cos(a) * r2, cy + math.sin(a) * r2, C .. "0.45)", 1) end local sw = t * 1.2 g.arc(cx, cy, 250, sw, sw + 0.9, A .. "0.6)", 3) local pulse = 26 + math.sin(t * 3) * 5 g.glow(cx, cy, pulse * 3, C .. "0.25)") g.circle(cx, cy, pulse * 0.4, C .. "0.9)") g.line(cx - 40, cy, cx - 14, cy, C .. "0.8)", 1.5) g.line(cx + 14, cy, cx + 40, cy, C .. "0.8)", 1.5) g.line(cx, cy - 40, cx, cy - 14, C .. "0.8)", 1.5) g.line(cx, cy + 14, cx, cy + 40, C .. "0.8)", 1.5) local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() targets, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 8 then break end local an = -1.95 + (i - 1) * 0.56 + (i > 4 and 0.98 or 0) local r = 370 local x, y = cx + math.cos(an) * r * 1.25, cy + math.sin(an) * r * 0.85 targets[#targets + 1] = {x = x, y = y, a = an, name = a.name, id = a.id} end for _, tg in ipairs(targets) do if over and math.abs(px - tg.x) < 70 and math.abs(py - tg.y) < 30 then hot = tg.id end end for _, tg in ipairs(targets) do local on = tg.id == hot local col = on and A or C local ex, ey = cx + math.cos(tg.a) * 292, cy + math.sin(tg.a) * 292 g.line(ex, ey, tg.x - (tg.x > cx and 70 or -70), tg.y, col .. "0.5)", 1) local bw, bh = 70, 26 for _, s in ipairs({{-1, -1}, {1, -1}, {1, 1}, {-1, 1}}) do local x0, y0 = tg.x + s[1] * bw, tg.y + s[2] * bh g.line(x0, y0, x0 - s[1] * 14, y0, col .. "0.9)", 2) g.line(x0, y0, x0, y0 - s[2] * 10, col .. "0.9)", 2) end if on then g.rect(tg.x - bw, tg.y - bh, bw * 2, bh * 2, A .. "0.12)") end g.text(tg.x - #tg.name * 4.3, tg.y - 10, tg.name, on and "#ffd27a" or "#bff6ff", 15, "JetBrainsMono") g.text(tg.x - bw, tg.y + bh + 4, string.format("%03d.%02d", math.floor(tg.x) % 1000, math.floor(tg.y) % 100), col .. "0.6)", 11, "JetBrainsMono") end for _, s in ipairs({{30, 30, 1, 1}, {w - 30, 30, -1, 1}, {30, h - 30, 1, -1}, {w - 30, h - 30, -1, -1}}) do g.line(s[1], s[2], s[1] + s[3] * 60, s[2], C .. "0.6)", 2) g.line(s[1], s[2], s[1], s[2] + s[4] * 60, C .. "0.6)", 2) end g.text(46, h - 74, string.format("PWR %3d%% TMP %d C LNK OK", 98 + math.floor(math.sin(t) * 2), 41), C .. "0.7)", 13, "JetBrainsMono") end function click(x, y) for _, tg in ipairs(targets) do if math.abs(x - tg.x) < 70 and math.abs(y - tg.y) < 30 then return "open:" .. tg.id end end end
